title: Sonadoba N.E.L.C jwngni mondoli
lyrics:
​Ch.
Sonadoba N.E.L.C. jwngni mondoli

Khusi-khusi jwnglai khusi, dinwi Jubilee-2

Phungbili jubilee, nwi jiba bwswrari

Sibigwn khulumgwn, boibw jwng firi-firi -2

Ha ha... lara la la-3:

(A) 

Rongjanaini dengkhw, sibinaini hangkhw 

Somaina girja, nwng jwngnw hwbai

Baonw haya jwng, hambai hwyw jwng

Aogai grwnai, ajou-ajwi fwrkhou -2

(B) 

Mondolikhou jwngni, ajaonanwi labai 

Nwi rwja maithaini, dinwini sanao

Hambai hwyw jwng, Gothaibari circle

Jwngkhou onnanwi, gojobna labai -2
